_comment: ThreePlayerTicTacToe locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is.

_slots.{symbol}: The player's mark, one of A, B or C
_slots.{row}: The board row index of the placed mark
_slots.{col}: The board column index of the placed mark
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII board (do not translate)
_slots.{moves}: The comma-separated list of available move tokens like '[4]' (do not translate)

player_prompt.intro:
Ikaw an Player {player_id} ha Three-Player Tic Tac Toe.
An imo simbolo amo an '{symbol}'.
Ikaw naghahatag han imo simbolo ha 5x5 nga bangga para makab-ot han usa ka linya han upat.
An mga linya puyde horizontal, vertical, o diagonal.
Isumite imo mugna ha pormato '[4]' para markahan an selula 4.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Diri-makatuman nga format han pagbalhin. Gamit an "[cell]" kun diin an selyula 0 - {max_cell} .
invalid_move.out_of_range: Baliw nga numero han selula: {cell}. Kinahanglan makasakop ha 0 ngan {max_cell}.
invalid_move.made_invalid: An player {player_id} in naghimo hin diri-makatarunganon nga paglihok.

game_action.placed: Nagpapahiang Player {player_id} han ira simbolo ({symbol}) ha sukod ({row}, {col}).
